name: Wild Tranquility Bloom
tooltip:
Wild Tranquility Bloom
5 yd range
2.5 sec cast
The environmental factors and changes of Quel'Thalas and the surrounding regions has had a profound impact on the local flora, including even the humble Peacebloom. It is still a staple of local crafting and is utilized in a wide variety of recipes, and a recent strain that has adapted to those changes has been dubbed Tranquility Bloom.

Zul'Aman -- a land rife with natural magic and ancient power. This power permeates all things in Zul'Aman, and has come to affect the herbs found within the region.

Gathering these wild herbs releases a burst of nature magic, giving rise to a group of hostile herb lashers that attempt to take vengeance!

Discovery: Midnight Gathering Nodes
